compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-5: deterministic tests/ regression fixture freezes the four Pattern 3 chain files' root-cause excerpts and runs the first fix's extracted query asserting >=4 matches; no original environment required.

Create tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh: run the first fix's extracted antipattern query against the four frozen fixtures under tests/fixtures/antipattern-chain/ and assert >=4 matches, with no original environment required. The extracted query is the exact signature: a CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT-style variable referenced under `set -u` WITHOUT a default guard (i.e. ${VAR} with no :- or :? ). Embed this signature constant directly in the test; do not re-derive it. The test is RED until task-6 has frozen all four fixtures. Set the executable bit on the new test file.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] New test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh
- [ ] Test passes GREEN against the frozen fixtures (asserts >=4 matches) — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh
- [ ] Test embeds the unguarded CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT-style ${VAR}/set -u query signature constant (not re-derived) — Verify asserts the guard-absence predicate is named, not incidental boilerplate — Verify: grep -qE 'PLUGIN_ROOT' tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh && grep -qiE '(unguarded|no[ _-]?default|without[ _-](:-|:\?| a default))' tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh
- [ ] Test asserts a >=4 match threshold — Verify: grep -qE '(-ge 4|>= *4|-gt 3)' tests/scripts/test-antipattern-chain-regression.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
